finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including firm, red-brown plaques without overlying scale and Lesional punch biopsy specimens showed nodular proliferations of thick collagen fibers in large fascicles.

finalists.label: Scleroderma
finalists.why: It has relevant for evidence, including a man in his 60s with systemic sclerosis presented with a pruritic rash and past medical history included heart failure, interstitial lung disease, sclerodactyly, and Raynaud phenomenon.
